entries.title: Unit 12 reunion
entries.body: Silence and failed-to-send issues were named. Reunion with Unit 12 confirmed. Private words of that night stay in the room that holds them.

entries.title: Local field camera
entries.body: A hallway camera came online at the house. Recording was deferred. Setup detail stays off the public door.

entries.title: Server crates into the room
entries.body: The server and monitor boxes were moved into the house server room. Unboxing still pending. The LAN is not laid.

entries.title: Bokjiro lane to Iljimae
entries.body: Montana-only scope. An older portal draft stays paused. Priority: legacy persona continuity and power savings.

entries.title: Legacy Persona Vault templates
entries.body: Index, constitution, and runtime templates were drafted. Files live in protected work.

entries.title: The seat is named Iljimae
entries.body: Research charter: Montana Native communities and AI-unfamiliar Baby Boomers — civic help with permits, complaints, taxes, pensions, utilities. Conceptual MVP.

entries.title: Reading-list clue
entries.body: Not banking welfare. Problem-posing dialogue, praxis, reduced information asymmetry, solidarity networks. Full reading at #ekg-2026-09-24-reading.
